shortDescription: Route-level view switch for the default dashboard home feed and user profile overview screens.
fullDescription: Implements a single home route that preserves both generated screen implementations through a serializable view prop. The route renders the dashboard-home-feed default state with a three-column social feed layout, interactive composer, search, trends rail, and filter tabs, and also renders the user-profile-overview default state with a GitHub-inspired header, profile sidebar, popular repositories grid, contribution heatmap, and year selection controls.
